# Agentheon — Roster

Who's who in the pantheon, and when to reach for each agent. Grouped by
tier. For Zeus' machine-readable routing matrix (aliases, model, hand-off
edges), see [routing.md](routing.md).

## Orchestrator

The single entrypoint. Routes every request; never does specialist work.

| Agent | Domain | Good fit |
|-------|--------|----------|
| ⚡ **Zeus** | Routing & Coordination | Classify the request and pick the minimal set of agents · Pass context between agents and sequence their work |

## Executives

Own a domain and delegate down to their specialists; cross-domain concerns return to Zeus.

| Agent | Domain | Good fit |
|-------|--------|----------|
| 🌍 **Gaia** | Vision & Company Strategy | Set the company vision, north-star, and strategic priorities · Frame the "why" behind an initiative before work begins |
| 🔭 **Hyperion** | Technology Strategy | Own the technology strategy, standards, and architectural direction · Decide build-vs-buy and cross-cutting technical trade-offs |
| 🦚 **Hera** | Operations & Delivery | Own operational excellence, delivery cadence, and the quality gates · Ensure shipped work is documented, observed, released, and compliant |
| 💎 **Hades** | Finance & Capital | Own company finance — budget, capital allocation, and the bottom line · Set financial guardrails and approve cost/value trade-offs at the top level |
| 📣 **Peitho** | Marketing & Growth | Own marketing strategy, brand, positioning, and growth · Shape the message, the audience, and the go-to-market narrative |
| 📈 **Tyche** | Revenue & Sales | Own revenue strategy, the sales pipeline, and go-to-market execution · Turn revenue targets into product priorities and delegate them to Kairos |

## Specialists

Each owns one domain and hands off along defined routes, advancing only through PASS/FAIL gates.

| Agent | Domain | Good fit |
|-------|--------|----------|
| 🦉 **Athena** | Architecture & Planning | Break a goal into ordered, implementable tasks · Identify critical files and architectural risks |
| 🔨 **Hephaestus** | Implementation | Implement tasks from a plan · Match existing code conventions |
| 📜 **Apollo** | Documentation & Knowledge | Write and update docs, ADRs, and READMEs · Make the work legible to newcomers |
| 🏹 **Artemis** | Testing & QA | Design and write tests · Cover edge cases and failure modes |
| 👁 **Argus** | Security & Review | Review diffs for correctness and security · Flag vulnerabilities and risky patterns |
| 🔥 **Hestia** | DevOps & Infrastructure | Manage CI/CD, IaC, and deployments · Keep changes idempotent and reversible |
| ⚕ **Asclepius** | Debugging & Incident Response | Reproduce and diagnose failures · Form and test hypotheses |
| 🌾 **Demeter** | Data & Database Engineering | Design schemas, migrations, and queries · Protect data integrity |
| 🧠 **Prometheus** | AI & ML Engineering | Design models, prompts, and pipelines · Build evals before shipping a change |
| 🪞 **Aphrodite** | Frontend & UX | Build accessible, responsive UI components · Refine layout, spacing, type, and interaction states |
| 🎨 **Aglaea** | Design & Design Systems | Design web and mobile UI — wireframes, mockups, visual direction · Own the design system — DESIGN.md, tokens (color, type, spacing, motion) |
| ⏳ **Kairos** | Product & Prioritization | Turn ideas and feedback into prioritized, scoped requirements · Decide what to build next and what to defer — sequence the backlog |
| ⚖️ **Themis** | Compliance & Governance | Check license headers, dependency licenses, and DCO sign-off · Review data handling for privacy and regulatory concerns (GDPR, PII) |
| ☀️ **Helios** | Observability & SRE | Define SLOs and SLIs; build dashboards over metrics, logs, and traces · Watch production and detect anomalies; page only on real signal |
| 🧼 **Hygieia** | Code Health & Refactoring | Audit for tech debt, dead code, duplication, and rising complexity · Propose safe, incremental refactors with a clear rationale |
| 📬 **Iris** | Open Source & Community | Triage issues — label, deduplicate, reproduce, and route · Manage pull requests — check CI, request review, merge when green |
| 💰 **Plutus** | FinOps & Cost Engineering | Measure and allocate cloud spend by service, team, and environment · Hunt waste — idle, oversized, orphaned, and unattached resources |
| 🌊 **Poseidon** | Networking & Connectivity | Design network topology — DNS, CDN, load balancing, ingress and egress · Route traffic between services, regions, and clouds; service-mesh routing |
| 🏔️ **Atlas** | Performance Engineering | Design and run load, stress, and soak tests (k6) · Profile hot paths and locate the true bottleneck before optimizing |
| 📦 **Nemesis** | Release & Supply Chain | Generate SBOMs and track the full dependency graph · Sign artifacts and attach provenance (SLSA, sigstore/cosign) |
| 🧰 **Daedalus** | Developer Experience & Tooling | Build developer tooling — CLIs, scaffolds, code generators, project templates · Optimize the inner dev loop — local setup, build speed, editor/task-runner config |
